## Task breakdown — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/tasks.md`

**32 tasks across 7 phases**, organized so each user story is an independently testable increment.

| Phase | Focus | Tasks |
|-------|-------|-------|
| 1. Setup | Project structure, dependencies, config | T001–T003 |
| 2. Foundational | Database, URL helpers, title-fetch, server skeleton | T004–T008 |
| 3. US1 — Save a bookmark (P1) 🎯 | Validate/normalise/auto-title/dedupe + save UI | T009–T013 |
| 4. US2 — Browse & open (P1) | List newest-first, open in new tab, empty state | T014–T018 |
| 5. US3 — Edit & delete (P2) | Update/delete + confirm step | T019–T023 |
| 6. US4 — Search & tags (P3) | Search, tag filter, no-results state | T024–T028 |
| 7. Polish | Playwright e2e, truncation, harness config, full validation | T029–T032 |

**Per story:** US1 = 5 tasks, US2 = 5, US3 = 5, US4 = 5 (plus 3 setup, 5 foundational, 4 polish).

**Suggested MVP scope:** US1 + US2 (both P1) — save, browse, and open bookmarks end-to-end.

**Parallel opportunities:** foundational helpers (T005/T006/T008), the paired test tasks within each story, and whole stories split across people after Phase 2.

**Tests included** (per the approved plan): `node --test` unit/API tests per story, and Playwright 1.61.0 end-to-end tests covering the quickstart scenarios in Phase 7.

**Format check:** all 32 tasks use the required `- [ ] Txxx [P?] [Story?] description + file path` format.

## Next gate

Spec ✅ and plan ✅ are both approved — so we've cleared the gates that block implementation. Before I run `speckit-implement`, two quick options:

- **Approve tasks → I proceed to implement** against this breakdown (I'll build the MVP first: Setup → Foundational → US1 → US2, then continue through US3/US4 and polish).
